name: Princess
source:
She/Her

Friends call her by the nickname "Princess" sarcastically because of her bad attitude. Works as a barista and usually hangs out around the EDM scene in town. Is a frequent user of a recreational drug called Numb X, which is a medicine used for pain. Even though life is not easy for her currently, everything changes when she awakens a strange new power within her.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/wacol/princess-of-worlds-end-urban-fantasy-game-about-addiction]Kickstarter[/url]]
